sovereign_country.strategic_role: 拉美西语近岸软件研发外包与数字客服中心

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Self-Insurance Risk Underwriting for Multinational Enterprise Groups

applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Colombia–Spain Convention for the Avoidance of Double Taxation (DTA)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Law 1121 of 2006 (AML/CFT); Law 1762 of 2015 (anti-corruption and asset laundering); Decree 624 of 1989 (Tax Statute) as amended by Law 2010 of 2019 and regulated by Decree 1091 of 2020 (Registro de Beneficiarios Finales - UBO register); Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia External Circular 012 of 2020 and Circular Básica Jurídica; UIAF (Unidad de Información y Análisis Financiero) PEP and sanctions screening protocols; Código de Comercio (Decree 410 of 1971).

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of good standing / Certificate of legal existence of the ultimate foreign parent shareholder (Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Home-jurisdiction Companies Registry or Registrar of Companies

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized Power of Attorney from the foreign parent to the Colombian legal representative for incorporation
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Public Notary in the parent's home country

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Sworn UBO declaration form (Declaración de Beneficiario Final) executed by each ultimate beneficial owner
Board resolution of the foreign parent appointing statutory representatives and confirming the Colombian registered office
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Board of Directors of the foreign parent company

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all shareholders, directors, and UBOs against the OFAC Sanctions List, United Nations Security Council Consolidated Sanctions List, EU restricted and asset-freeze lists, the UIAF PEP database, and the Colombian National Government anti-corruption list. Politically Exposed Persons (PEPs), their families, and close associates must be identified and risk-rated under Law 1121 of 2006 and SFC Circular Básica Jurídica. Enhanced due diligence is mandatory for any non-resident UBO or PEP owning at least 10% of the captive reinsurance SPV, and the SFC requires an AML/SARLAFT matrix before the captive reinsurance license is granted.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: RUES (Registro Único Empresarial y Social) - www.rues.gov.co
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Per the Código de Comercio (Decree 410 of 1971) and regulatory criteria of the Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio (SIC), the proposed name must be expressed in the Latin alphabet and preferably in Spanish; foreign-language names are admissible only if transliterated into Spanish phonetics. The denomination must contain a distinctive headword, may include an activity descriptor, and must end with the legal tag 'S.A.S.' The RUES index normalizes accents, spaces, hyphens, plurals, and phonetic variants for exact and similarity-based collision checks.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Within ten (10) business days of rejection, the applicant must file a 'recurso de reposición' before the chamber of commerce that issued the rejection, attaching the RUES homonimia certificate, the proposed name and alternatives, and written grounds of distinctiveness. If the chamber upholds the rejection, a 'recurso de apelación' may be filed before the Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio (SIC) within five (5) business days; the SIC must issue a decision within thirty (30) business days. Failure to appeal within the applicable deadlines makes the rejection final.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: The S.A.S. regime tolerates a registered office that is an administrative/virtual service-provider address for general incorporation purposes. However, for a captive reinsurance SPV that requires an SFC license, the Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia mandates a physical Colombian operational office with permanent staff, corporate records, governance meeting space, and AML/SARLAFT procedures. A purely postal or remote virtual office is not licensable.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Pre-incorporation probability of unannounced inspection is low (approximately 10%); after the SFC licensing application is filed, the probability increases to approximately 55%; once captive reinsurance operations commence, the annual probability of an unannounced SFC and/or DIAN on-site inspection is high, estimated at approximately 75% during the first 24 months.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Commercial registry name clearance fee (homonimia) at the local Chamber of Commerce
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Cámara de Comercio of the registered seat
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff published by the Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio and applicable chamber fee schedule

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarization of incorporation bylaws and UBO oath declaration
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Government-approved notarial tariff schedule (Decree 1784 of 2013 and updates)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Hague Apostille certificates for four foreign parent corporate documents
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Home jurisdiction's competent Apostille authority (e.g., Secretary of State, Ministry of Foreign Affairs)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory per-document apostille fee in the parent's home country

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Local counsel pre-incorporation due diligence, UBO piercing investigation, and legal risk assessment
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Colombian law firm engaged for the formation
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark fixed fee for cross-border S.A.S. formation with SFC-licensed captive reinsurance scope

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Certified Spanish translation of foreign parent corporate documents
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market rate per original page (COP 50,000–75,000 per page equivalent)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: UBO and AML database screening package (World-Check / UIAF batch screening)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: AML/KYC data provider or recognized screening intermediary
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Per-search subscription or transactional market tariff

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Law 1258 of 2008 on the Sociedad por Acciones Simplificada (S.A.S.), arts. 1-47; Colombian Commercial Code (Decreto 410 de 1971), arts. 98-110 and 373-394 (registro mercantil); Decreto 2555 de 2010, Libro 4 (financial supervision and authorization of insurance and reinsurance entities, as amended by the SFC captive regime instructions); Circular Básica Jurídica (Circular Externa 029 de 2014) for corporate governance and SARLAFT.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Cámara de Comercio with territorial jurisdiction over the registered office, operating through the Registro Único Empresarial (RUES) and Confecámaras network; operational authorization from the Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia (SFC) for captive reinsurance activity.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Documento Privado de Constitución (signed and signature-legalized) or Escritura Pública No. ___ if in-kind real property is contributed; registered in the Registro Mercantil; definitive proof is the Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal issued by the Chamber of Commerce.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital applies to the S.A.S. under Law 1258/2008; however, the SFC requires the captive reinsurer to maintain a regulatory minimum subscribed and paid-in capital (per Decreto 2555/2010, adjusted by SFC regulation, reduced floor available for captives covering only parent-group risks), fully paid in cash and deposited in a blocked bank account pending final licensing.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: FIRST BOARD RESOLUTION (PRO-FORMA). RESOLVED: 1) the initial share subscription is approved and each founder's contribution is accepted, payable in cash; 2) the registered office is fixed at the address to be inscribed in the Registro Mercantil and the statutory books are opened; 3) the sole director (Representante Legal) and alternate are appointed with full powers for registry, banking, labor and fiscal acts; 4) the paid-up capital shall be deposited in a blocked bank account at a supervised Colombian entity pending the Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia's authorization; 5) management is authorized to file the captive reinsurance license application and adopt the required AML, solvency and corporate governance manuals; 6) the secretary shall certify this resolution with legalized signatures.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution and Signature Legalization of the Constitution Document
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notaría Pública or Cámara de Comercio venue (autenticación)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Documento Privado de Constitución containing the mandatory S.A.S. clauses: corporate purpose restricted to captive reinsurance, nominal capital, classes of shares, governance rules, succession rights, and dispute resolution. All founders or their attorneys-in-fact must sign with legalized signatures. Concurrently, request the provisional NIT (pre-RUT) through the DIAN electronic portal.
required_dossiers: Documento Privado de Constitución (S.A.S. bylaws)
Legalized signatures (autenticación notarial)
ID copies of individual shareholders or corporate existence certificates of foreign shareholders (apostilled)
Power of attorney if signatory is not a direct shareholder
Pre-RUT printout from DIAN
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the chamber or notary objects to clauses, execute an amendment to the constitution document by private instrument and re-legalize signatures; a notarial deed is required only if real estate is contributed.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Merchant Registration and Tax Identification Activation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio (RUES) and DIAN (Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the legalized constitution document with the competent Chamber of Commerce, complete the RUES forms and the Registro Único de Beneficiarios Finales, pay the registration fee and municipal registry tax, and obtain the Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal. The chamber will transmit the registration to DIAN to convert the pre-RUT into a definitive RUT with NIT; request the electronic invoicing resolution only when operational transactions commence.
required_dossiers: Legalized Documento Privado de Constitución
Pre-RUT/NIT provisional certificate
RUES and Beneficiario Final registration forms
Payment receipt for registration fees and registry tax
Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal (issued after entry)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Rectify data errors by filing a correction request at the chamber within 5 business days (Código de Comercio art. 65); if DIAN rejects the RUT conversion, appear at the DIAN office with the chamber-issued certificate to cure mismatched legal representative or address fields.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Blocked Capital Deposit and Opening of Corporate Bank Account
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Supervised Colombian credit institution (bank) and the SFC (supervision of capital deposit evidence)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a corporate savings or checking account in a SFC-supervised bank and deposit the full subscribed paid-up capital as approved by the board; the bank must issue a deposit certificate indicating that funds are blocked subject to SFC authorization. This certificate, together with the RUT, is required for the licensing stage.
required_dossiers: Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal
Definitive RUT with NIT
Board resolution appointing the legal representative and designating account signatories
Bank onboarding forms and KYC documents of shareholders and legal representative
Capital deposit certificate (blocked account)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank requires additional KYC, provide certified copies of shareholder corporate documents with apostilles; if the capital block is refused due to product restrictions, request a temporary certificate of deposit (CDT) in the company's name pending SFC licensing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: SFC Prior Authorization and Captive Reinsurance Operating License
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia (SFC) – Delegatura para Entidades Aseguradoras y Reaseguradoras
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the formal application for authorization of constitution and operation as a captive reinsurance entity, including the three-year technical-financial feasibility plan, reserve and solvency computations, capital certification, governance structure, independent revisor fiscal designation, and SARLAFT (AML/CFT) manual in line with Circular Básica Jurídica. The SFC will issue an administrative act granting the license after verifying legal and financial soundness; do not underwrite any reinsurance contracts before the license is granted.
required_dossiers: SFC application form (Formato Único de Diligencias)
Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal and RUT
Blocked capital deposit certificate issued by the bank
Three-year technical-financial feasibility study with actuarial reserve calculations
SARLAFT/AML manual and corporate governance and solvency manuals
Appointment documents of the Revisor Fiscal and compliance officer
Background and suitability information of shareholders and directors (idóneidad)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the SFC issues a deficiency notice, respond within the granted term (typically 10-15 business days) with corrected documentation; if the license is denied, file a recurso de reposición within 10 business days and, where appropriate, a subsidiary appeal before the SFC or the National Government.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-License Operational Setup and Municipal Employment Registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio, Municipal Treasury (ICA), ARL and Caja de Compensación
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After the SFC license is issued, register the start of operations with the Municipal Treasury (Industria y Comercio), enroll the company as an employer in the PILA system with a Caja de Compensación Familiar and an ARL (Seguridad y Salud en el Trabajo), and register the workplace premises with the local authorities. Update the RUES commercial registry with the SFC license number.
required_dossiers: SFC license (resolución de autorización)
Lease contract or proof of ownership of the registered office
Municipal ICA registration form
PILA, Caja de Compensación and ARL registration forms
Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal (updated)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Late registration penalties are cured by filing the corresponding declarations with interest and surcharges before the municipal administration and by obtaining the good-standing certificates from the ARL and Caja.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia (SFC) – Delegatura para Entidades Aseguradoras y Reaseguradoras; no physical manufacturing authority is involved as the captive operates exclusively as a financial-services SPV.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Autorización de Constitución y de Funcionamiento como Sociedad de Reaseguro Cautiva (licencia de funcionamiento SFC)

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exenta – Category 3: no EIA required for insurance/reinsurance services; the entity is a financial intermediary with no industrial process; only a voluntary registration and compliance with municipal office-related environmental rules apply.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No industrial effluents or VOC emissions are generated by the captive reinsurance SPV; office wastewater must comply with municipal non-domestic discharge standards (Resolución 0631 de 2015 thresholds, e.g., pH 6.0-9.0, BOD5 <= 600 mg/L where applicable); electronic and solid waste must be handled under Resolución 1407 de 2018 and municipal waste ordinances.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire-safety approval from the Cuerpo de Bomberos (Certificado de Bomberos) for the registered office; structural load inspection and use-of-land certification (Certificado de Uso de Suelo) issued by the Curaduría Urbana or local planning office; workplace occupational clearance under Resolución 0312 de 2019 (SGSST), including ARL affiliation, emergency plan, and electrical safety checklist per RETIE.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN), principal portal https://www.dian.gov.co; transactional gateway 'MUISCA' at https://muisca.dian.gov.co for e-registration, NIT issuance, electronic declarations and invoicing services.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Step 1: Pre-register the foreign parent/shareholder with DIAN through a local attorney or accredited foreign representative to obtain a DIAN authorization code. Step 2: Incorporate the Sociedad por Acciones Simplificada (S.A.S.) by public deed before a Colombian notary, appointing a legal representative and a local tax agent; where the captive will operate as a reinsurer, obtain the requisite authorization from the Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia. Step 3: Submit the incorporation deed, Spanish-language bylaws, proof of registered address and alien/shareholder identification to DIAN to obtain the Registro Único Tributario (RUT) and the NIT (Número de Identificación Tributaria). Step 4: Complete the RUT positions for income tax, VAT, withholding at source, and electronic invoicing emitter. Step 5: Keep the RUT validated and renew it every two years or upon any material change in tax domicile, shareholding or activity.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No U.S.-style check-the-box election exists in Colombia. The S.A.S. is a domestic corporation taxed at entity level on worldwide income. Relevant elective mechanisms include: (i) the fiscal consolidation group election under ET arts. 148-1 et seq., available to qualifying domestic economic groups with 75% or greater common shareholding and prior DIAN authorization; (ii) accelerated depreciation elections for new fixed assets; (iii) annual or multi-year advanced pricing agreements with DIAN on transfer pricing; and (iv) the option to treat certain hybrid instruments consistently under Colombian anti-hybrid rules, but no unilateral elective opt-out is permitted.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: VAT (Impuesto al Valor Agregado — IVA) under the National Tax Statute, Article 420 et seq.; complemented by the National Consumption Tax and specific financial transaction taxes.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: For legal entities, there is no economic turnover threshold: every S.A.S. performing taxable or potentially taxable operations must register as a VAT responsible within the RUT regardless of revenue volume. Natural persons under the simplified regime historically qualified up to 3,500 UVT, but that regime is not available to a corporate captive reinsurance SPV; a zero threshold applies to legal entities.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory real-time electronic invoicing through DIAN's ecosystem. The S.A.S. must issue 'Factura Electrónica de Venta' (FEV) using DIAN-approved software or the free MUISCA emulator; each invoice must bear the CUFE (Código Único de Facturación), QR/verification stamp, digital signature and XML/CII schema, and must be transmitted to DIAN for validation before delivery. VAT returns must be filed electronically on form F-100, with automatic cross-checks against invoices, customs declarations and FX reintegro reports. Digital stamping, real-time fiscal clearance and full XML archival are mandatory.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Colombia applies 0% VAT (ventas exentas con derecho a compensación) to exports of goods and qualifying export services under ET art. 481 and Decree 1625/2016. A service qualifies when rendered to a foreign person, delivered or used entirely abroad, and not connected with Colombian territory or with a Colombian resident's economic activity. Captive reinsurance premium income is generally an excluded operation (fuera del hecho generador del IVA) rather than zero-rated; nevertheless, management, underwriting and claims services performed by the same Colombian S.A.S. for the foreign parent/reinsurer may be classified as export services and invoiced at 0% if (i) the client is a foreign related party, (ii) the services are economically used outside Colombia, and (iii) full contractual, intra-group, transfer pricing and banking documentation is retained. The SPV must mark its RUT as exporter and file the corresponding export-service declaration to sustain the 0% treatment.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Declaración de Exportación) — mandatory where goods are physically exported; for pure reinsurance services, a sworn export-service declaration may be required as evidentiary support.
Bill of Lading or air waybill (Conocimiento de Embarque) — when transport or insured goods are involved.
Inward remittance certificate (Certificado de Reintegro de Divisas) issued by a Colombian authorized FX intermediary, confirming foreign currency collection.
Ceded reinsurance treaty, risk-participation agreement or export services contract, identifying the foreign counterparty and economic use abroad.
DIAN-validated electronic invoice (Factura Electrónica de Venta) bearing CUFE and evidencing the 0% rate.
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Fraudulent zero-rating claims trigger reimbursement of omitted VAT, daily interest, and a penalty under ET art. 647 increased to 160% of the tax difference when the inaccuracy is considered fraudulent. Improperly obtained or refunded balances are clawed back with an additional 15% sanction under ET art. 670. Criminal tax evasion under Law 1943/2018 may also lead to imprisonment. The DIAN audit window is five years, expanding to ten years for related-party transactions. Cross-validation combines the F-100 VAT return, customs records, electronic invoices, remittance evidence and transfer pricing documentation; failure to repatriate within 180 days may also trigger Colombian foreign-exchange penalties and loss of the 0% rate.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banco de la República de Colombia (central bank) and the Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN) as foreign exchange administration supervisors, with all transactions executed through authorized foreign exchange intermediaries registered with the Financial Superintendence of Colombia (SFC).
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Colombian peso (COP) is fully convertible for current account items (trade, services and ordinary remittances) via the foreign exchange market, subject to mandatory channeling through authorized intermediaries and exchange declarations. Capital account transactions, including foreign direct investment in a Colombian S.A.S. captive reinsurance SPV, are freely permitted but must be registered with Banco de la República through an authorized intermediary; profit remittance is permitted after the relevant tax obligation is discharged and requires evidence of duly registered foreign capital and audited financial statements. Non-resident investors do not need domicile or residency for incorporation, but reinvestment and capital reductions must be lodged in the foreign investment registration file to ensure future legal repatriation.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Export proceeds of goods and services must be received within the commercial credit terms authorized by Banco de la República, generally up to six months from the date of shipment or accrual unless an extended pre-financing or foreign-credit arrangement is approved, and must be channelled through an authorized FX intermediary in Colombia. The statutory standard effectively requires 100% channeling and reintegration of the export value into the local financial system; however, the proceeds may be kept in foreign currency in Colombian intermediary accounts only to the extent allowed by Banco de la República and must be converted into COP or otherwise negotiated on the exchange market if needed to settle operational obligations. Non-compliance triggers exchange surcharges (multas cambiarias) and administrative sanctions under the Colombian FX regime.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low viability for treasury-critical functions. Colombia does not recognize offshore e-money institutions or unlicensed EMIs as authorized FX intermediaries, and a captive reinsurance SPV cannot legally use an offshore EMI as the ultimate clearing bank for inbound or outbound reinsurance premiums, claims or capital flows. Local licensed fintech institutions supervised by the SFC (e.g., specialized digital banks and regulated payment providers) may offer efficient payment initiation rails, but the final legal settlement and FX conversion must occur through a licensed Colombian credit institution or an authorized FX intermediary.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical presence of the legal representative or a duly appointed attorney-in-fact is ordinarily required when opening material corporate, escrow and FX-bearing accounts in Colombia, together with notarial certification of corporate powers and identification. Some leading banks allow a hybrid remote/electronic onboarding if robust digital identity verification, biometric checks and certified corporate documents are submitted, but the final decision remains with the bank's compliance committee; the SFC's AML/CFT rules favor the bank's ability to validate beneficial ownership in person. A videoconference interview is usually accepted only as a supplement, not a complete substitute, for the face-to-face verification of ultimate beneficial owners in a non-resident captive reinsurance structure.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Entity classified as an 'offshore captive insurance vehicle' with non-resident shareholders and low operational substance in Colombia.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified articles of incorporation of the S.A.S.; resolution from the Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia or equivalent evidence of the statutory insurance/reinsurance authorization; organizational substance file including administration office, actuarial personnel, board minutes, business plan and risk management policies; ultimate beneficial owner registry declaration; audited financial statements and third-party economic substance references.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Cross-border premium/reinsurance flows originating from high-risk jurisdictions or family-owned multinational groups.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Group corporate chart and shareholder register; underlying insurance policies, risk participation agreements, and quota-share / excess of loss contracts; premium invoices and settlement metadata; UBO and negative-media screening reports; for-source-of-funds bank statements and notarized commitment letters from the parent/cedant.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Use of high financial leverage, escrow deposits, anticipated premium financing, or projected reserve structures that may resemble money laundering or shell activity.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Actuarial reserve report certified by a registered actuary; reinsurance technical agreement and claims projection methodology; liquidity and banking policy approved by the board; declaration of returnable funds and legitimate economic purpose; anti-money-laundering clearance letter from the group's designated compliance officer.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: PEP (politically exposed person) as shareholder, director, or ultimate beneficiary.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Enhanced due diligence file, PEP declaration, source-of-wealth statement supported by tax returns and bank/origin documents; independent search from recognized political exposure databases; board-approved risk acceptance memorandum and transaction monitoring safeguards.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Capital contribution from the non-resident parent must be sent by SWIFT MT103 to the SPV's operative or escrow account at a tier-1 Colombian bank using a remittence reference matching the foreign investment registration. The commercial concept must be declared as foreign direct investment (inversión extranjera), and the authorized FX intermediary must process the foreign-exchange operation and file the appropriate exchange declaration with Banco de la República. Documentary verification includes certified S.A.S. incorporation and registered investment ad-hoc certificate, share subscription agreement, source-of-funds and beneficial ownership deliverables. Funds may be credited in COP or foreign currency only as permitted by the local intermediary, and the investment must be recorded in the local registration before any future capital reduction or dividend repatriation.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Reinsurance claims, profit commissions, reserve funding and reinsurance premium cessions to the parent or ceding carriers are settled by SWIFT MT103 for cross-border transfers, whose payment order must contain the underlying reinsurance contract code, policy reference, and Banco de la República exchange category. For goods-related services or specialized trade settlements, an irrevocable commercial letter of credit confirmed by a Colombian bank may be used if the underlying debt documentation and transport/certificate evidence support the drawing. Local operating disbursements in COP may be cleared through the Colombian low-value payment systems and the high-value settlement system operated under SFC/central-bank oversight, provided suitable liquidity is maintained in the operative account.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Forwards on the TRM (tasa representativa del mercado) with authorized Colombian banks
Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) referencing COP/foreign currency, entered through authorized offshore/local intermediaries for hedging genuine exposure
Cross-currency swaps (CCS) between COP and the funding currency, limited to documented underlying obligations
FX options (calls/puts) executed over-the-counter with licensed entities, subject to SFC suitability rules

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Commercial Registry Renewal (Renovación de la Matrícula Mercantil)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late renewal incurs a monthly surcharge of approximately 10% of the renewal fee; persistent non-renewal may lead to suspension and eventual administrative cancellation of the commercial registration.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Statutory Financial Statements Filing (Estados Financieros de Propósito General)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Cámara de Comercio (Chamber of Commerce) and Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia (for regulated SPV)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Approved at the shareholders' meeting held within the first three months of the year; filed with the Chamber of Commerce within one month after approval (absolute deadline April 30)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to file results in Chamber of Commerce fines (up to 20 monthly minimum wages), restrictions on obtaining commercial certificates, and potential business registry suspension.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Ultimate Beneficial Owner (UBO) Confirmation and Report
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: DIAN – Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (National Tax and Customs Directorate)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually aligned with the income tax return calendar (typically between April and July, staggered by NIT last digit)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Omission or incorrect UBO data triggers penalty under Article 651 of the Colombian Tax Statute, up to 5,000 UVT (approx. USD 42,500), plus potential declaration invalidity.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Supervisory Financial and Compliance Return to Financial Superintendence
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 30 calendar days after the end of the fiscal year (by January 30) or as specifically required in SFC circulars for captive reinsurance SPVs
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late or incomplete filing may subject the SPV to SFC administrative fines, increased regulatory oversight, or license suspension for serious non-compliance.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: A Revisor Fiscal (statutory auditor) is compulsory if gross assets exceed 5,000 SMMLV (approx. COP 5.3 billion in 2024) or annual gross revenue exceeds 3,000 SMMLV. Captive reinsurance SPVs supervised by the Financial Superintendence are mandatorily subject to annual external audit and Revisor Fiscal regardless of size.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS as issued by IASB, adopted in Colombia through Decree 2420 of 2015; captive reinsurance SPVs must additionally apply the specific accounting plan prescribed by SFC Circular Externa 011 of 2017.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The SAS must maintain an updated share ledger and internal UBO record. Any transfer affecting ultimate beneficial ownership must be reflected in the share ledger and reported to DIAN in the next annual UBO confirmation cycle. The legal representative must certify UBO information annually within the income tax return; failure to update constitutes a compliance infraction.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Directors and Legal Representatives
Minute Book of Shareholders/Assembly (Libro de Actas)

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 200–500 per year (commissary or office registration fees in Bogotá/Medellín)
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 5,000–12,000 per year for a captive reinsurance SPV audited under Colombian GAAS and IFRS

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 35% (CIT rate for FY2024 and FY2025, per Law 2277 of 2022; applicable to the SAS as a resident entity)
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: No general tax holiday for reinsurance SPVs. Captive reinsurers may deduct technical reserve build-ups (reservas técnicas) within Financial Superintendency limits and premiums ceded to retrocessionaires. Taxable income for a captive is taxed at flat 35%; an additional 3% surcharge applies only to supervised financial institutions (not a SAS captive unless licensed entity qualifies). Tax losses may be carried forward indefinitely (0-year hard cap) and offset against future ordinary income—annual offset may be limited under anti-fragmentation rules.
